primitives.name: Route Win Rate
primitives.verbatim_quote: Route Win Rate **What:** WR route-win % — core input to Robbed Score, inventoried via @AjayTakes 2026-10-05 PM.
primitives.assumptions: Assumes clean NFLVERSE/charting data with accurate route classifications and tracking.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Degenerates when route sample size is too small, leading to unreliable estimates.

layer2.mapping: RouteWinRate maps to GSI posterior probability of successful route execution given defender proximity and route type. It serves as a derived kernel in GSE state-transition models for receiver-targeting decisions.
layer2.telemetry: Observed variance in RouteWinRate across different route types and defender match-ups.

primitives.name: Yards Per Route Run
primitives.verbatim_quote: YPRR (Yards Per Route Run) **What:** Standard WR/TE efficiency metric.
primitives.assumptions: Assumes accurate route classification and separation data from NFLVERSE/charting.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Fails when route counts are sparse, producing noisy estimators.

layer2.mapping: YPRR translates to a GSI efficiency parameter measuring receiver separation quality per route. In GSE, it informs state-transition probabilities for receiver-targeting during downs.
layer2.telemetry: Regression slope of receiving yards on route count, adjusted for defender proximity.

primitives.name: (True Pass Set variant)
primitives.verbatim_quote: True Pass Set variant) **What:** ESPN pass-rush win rate; @ColeJacksonFB 2026-10-05 PM item 48 specifies the "True pass set" variant (cleaner signal).
primitives.assumptions: Assumes ESPN's cleaned pass-rush dataset without sacks or scrambles.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Breaks down when defensive line sample sizes are insufficient for reliable win-rate estimation.

layer2.mapping: TruePassSetPRWR maps to a GSI defensive effectiveness measure, serving as a derived kernel in GSE quarterback-pressure state-transition models.
layer2.telemetry: Observed pass-rush win rates for individual defensive linemen, adjusted for opponent offensive line quality.

primitives.name: Robbed Score — Buy-Low Signal
primitives.verbatim_quote: Robbed Score — @AjayTakes (2026-10-05 PM, item 1) **What:** Buy-low WR composite: (Route Win Rate - TPRR) + uncatchable target % + (XFPTS - FPTS), mapped vs Separation Score.
primitives.assumptions: Assumes XFPTS and FPTS are well-calibrated fantasy projections, and separation data is accurate.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Degenerates when fantasy point values are mispriced or when separation signals are weak.

layer2.mapping: RobbedScoreBuyLowSignal maps to a GSI relative-value metric comparing observed receiver performance to expected performance based on route efficiency and separation. In GSE, it drives tactical targeting adjustments.
layer2.telemetry: Residual between actual and predicted fantasy points, conditional on route efficiency and defender proximity.

RouteWinRate and YPRR provide empirical measures of receiver skill and separation quality, while TruePassSetPRWR quantifies defensive pressure. RobbedScoreBuyLow integrates these into a predictive buy-low signal, leveraging both receiver inefficiency and defender mismatch. The primitives' failure modes—small sample sizes and mispriced fantasy values—are mitigated through hierarchical Bayesian shrinkage in GSI and conformal prediction in GSE.
